frictions.description: POST /operator/reservations/book/reservations requires an Idempotency-Key header; the first create attempt returned 400 missing_idempotency_key (user-testing.md mentions Idempotency-Key only generically).
frictions.resolution: Added Idempotency-Key to the create helper; evidence of the 400 kept in val-host-014-create-missing-idem.txt.

frictions.description: Booking create auto-assigns a table when no tableIds are sent, so 'a booking with no tables' is not directly creatable; the fix's precondition needed an explicit unassign.
frictions.resolution: POST /book/reservations/:id/assign {tableIds: [], expectedVersion} returns 200 and clears the assignment (soft); then ran arrived -> seated with tableIds.

frictions.description: GET /operator/reservations/setup/locations/:id/conflicts runs the reflow engine, so a GET can write (auto_reassigned events, day-version bumps). Observed day versions grow across repeated conflict calls.
frictions.resolution: Accepted as product behavior (route is the only way to read conflicts); noted for synthesis because the contract describes it as a read view.

frictions.description: rsv_day_versions does not increment exactly +1 per block create/delete (2026-10-31 went none -> 3 on the first block create; +2 per later op).
frictions.resolution: Recorded actual increments; the contract requires an increment, which holds.

frictions.description: Day-feed counters treat 'active' as status not in (cancelled, no_show) and include 'finished' rows; the contract phrase 'active reservations' is ambiguous.
frictions.resolution: Verified counters equal the returned filtered set under the implementation's definition and recorded the exact statuses per query so synthesis can judge.

frictions.description: The round-2 notes' 2026-10-16 split ('2 in svc_acme_lunch, the rest in svc_acme_dinner') no longer matches live data: 5 rows now reference the G5 leftover service srv_dbfce54a (2026-11-02..05 effective window).
frictions.resolution: Computed filter expectations from the live rows instead of the note; no shared rows were modified.

summary: Tested 6 assertions (API halves): 6 pass, 0 fail, 0 blocked. Round-1 root causes are fixed on the live tenant-api (3007): location-scoped DELETE aliases for pacing and service-availability answer 401 without a token and 2xx with one (legacy routes still work, cross-location refused with 404); POST /setup/blocks accepts the App form payload {businessDate,startMin,endMin} (201, was 500) and expands area blocks to all 6 active tables, reflows the soft booking (T2 -> G9-2, auto_reassigned + day-feed moveNotice) and increments rsv_day_versions; GET conflicts returns real items with kind/bookingId/tableId|serviceId and details.businessDate (verified 6 real + 1 self-owned blocked_table on 2026-10-31); the book day feed filters by serviceId/areaId/source/tag with counters equal to the filtered active set and per-query ETags (8 distinct, stable, 304 on If-None-Match); arrived -> seated honours tableIds (200, seatedAt set, rsv_table_occupancies row on T1 with the right window, day feed tableIds non-empty) and returns 409 with no occupancy/status change when the table is occupied without overbook. Not exercised here: all UI halves (r2-setup-ui, r2-book-ui, r2-floor), the pacing availability-cap effect, and the service-availability mode effect on slot search. Evidence: 70+ curl transcripts and sqlite SELECT outputs under evidence/foh-core/r2-api/. Leftovers on my owned date 2026-10-31: B1 rsv_54e2c979 (booked, reflowed to G9-2), B2 rsv_e7d17bb1 (seated T1), B3 rsv_680f3f28 (arrived, 409 case), all R2-API- prefixed; R2-API-Service srv_f3aa21cd remains (effective 2026-11-06) with zero pacing/availability rules; no blocks remain on 2026-10-31.
